acceptance_criteria: Two identical executions produce identical canonical bytes and receipts; source files remain byte-identical.
Preserve scalars, distributions, confidence where available, three auxiliary Bernoulli observations, full payload and native routes even when argmax disagrees.
Omit probability scoring on every row with explicit reason; retain native values and all 603 outcomes; 27 exclusions are fully accounted.
Selection inputs include exact prediction subsets bound to the same whole golden bytes; cannot silently filter during evaluation.

verification.procedure: Run python scripts/acceptance/prepare_chord.py --bundle <frozen-root> --out <fresh-output> twice in separate directories; compare exact hashes of all canonical outputs and receipts and all frozen source hashes. For cohort artifacts use --selection <config-path>; it emits the exactly aligned prediction subset.
